title: Schedule of Free Night Awards Issue Sources, Deposit Windows and Validity
content:
Ashbury Rewards issues Free Night Awards from three sources: co-brand card account anniversaries, elite night milestones and completed registered promotions. Each award type is tied to one source.

## Schedule

| Award type | Issue source | Qualifying occasion | Elite night credits in the calendar year for a milestone award | Co-brand card required | Deposited within (calendar days) | Validity (calendar months from issue date to expiry date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 25K Free Night Award | Registered promotion | A completed registered promotion | 0 (not a milestone award) | None | 7 | 6 |
| 35K Free Night Award | Co-brand card account anniversary | Anniversary of an Ashbury Rewards Card account | 0 (not a milestone award) | Ashbury Rewards Card | 56 | 12 |
| 40K Free Night Award | Elite night milestone | 50 elite night credits in one calendar year | 50 | None | 10 | 12 |
| 50K Free Night Award | Elite night milestone | 75 elite night credits in one calendar year | 75 | None | 10 | 12 |
| 85K Free Night Award | Co-brand card account anniversary | Anniversary of an Ashbury Rewards Premier Card account | 0 (not a milestone award) | Ashbury Rewards Premier Card | 56 | 12 |
| Any Hotel Free Night Award | Elite night milestone | 100 elite night credits in one calendar year | 100 | None | 10 | 12 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Deposit window.** The deposit window is the number of calendar days after the qualifying anniversary, milestone or promotion within which the award is deposited.
2. **Validity.** Validity is the number of calendar months from the issue date to the expiry date.
3. **How the expiry date is found.** For every award type the expiry date falls on the same day number as the issue date, or on the last day of the month when that month has no such day.
4. **Extension.** For every award type the expiry date cannot be extended.

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates)

- A hypothetical 40K Free Night Award issued on 14 March of one year, with 12 months of validity, falls due on 14 March of the following year.
- A hypothetical 25K Free Night Award issued on 31 August, with 6 months of validity, reaches February of the following year; February has no 31st, so the expiry date is the last day of that February.
